subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrowed policy that makes Google/Gemini auth-profile env refs file-backed in generated service environments while leaving other auth-profile env refs unchanged?
rationale: The mechanics are source-backed and proven, but CI cannot decide whether the provider-specific credential-delivery boundary is the intended security and compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
options.body: Merge this PR once maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

options.title: Request Generic Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR if all provider auth-profile env refs should share one common file-backed policy instead of this allowlist.

options.title: Keep Auth-Profile Rendering Separate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the linked issue limited to config SecretRefs and separate auth-profile work later.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR once maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus recently authored and landed the current-main config SecretRef half of this exact service-env security cluster.
